title: Grusch asks Brent to help bring John Harrington forward
summary: Brent Friedman tells of Grusch asks Brent to help bring John Harrington forward, about 2020s at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: No, I was just going to say I mean this is part of what Dave Gush was asking is like could you help make this happen?

plain: A man named Brent Friedman, speaking on a podcast episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says that David Grusch, a whistleblower who spoke publicly about secret UFO programmes in the 2020s, asked him for help bringing a man named John Harrington forward. Friedman tells it as part of an effort, if true, to get another person with something to say into the open.
